A numbered record of money received: one per payment, or one per payment-request payment. Numbers run in one series per business and are assigned within seconds of the payment. A receipt is not a tax invoice and never changes after it is created.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/receipts`](/help/developers/api-reference/receipts/list-receipts) | List receipts |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/receipts/{rcpt}`](/help/developers/api-reference/receipts/get-a-receipt) | Get a receipt |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/receipts/{rcpt}/pdf`](/help/developers/api-reference/receipts/download-a-receipt-pdf) | Download a receipt PDF |
